title: The Trinity
description: God is one God who exists eternally as three persons — Father, Son, and Holy Spirit — equal in glory, united in purpose.

waypoints.title: One God, Three Persons
waypoints.body: This is a mystery no human illustration fully captures, but the Bible plainly reveals all three persons: the Father who sent, the Son who came, and the Holy Spirit who dwells in believers -- one God, not three.

waypoints.title: Spot the Three
waypoints.body: This week, notice one thing the Father does, one thing Jesus does, and one thing the Holy Spirit does in the Bible stories you hear, and talk about it as a family.
